newsitem.title: USA: Sunpharm names Tracy new board chairman.
newsitem.headline: Sunpharm names Tracy new board chairman.

text.p: SunPharm Corp said Monday that Philip Tracy, former president and chief executive of Burroughs Wellcome Co, has been elected chairman of its board of directors. The company said Tracy replaces Jacques Rejeange, who will remain on the board.
The company also said Jerry Jackson, retired executive vice president of Merck & Co Inc, has been appointed to its board.
Tracy was president of Burroughs Wellcome from 1989 to 1995. Tracy is currently of counsel at the law firm of Smith, Anderson, Blount, Dorsett, Mitchell & Jernigan, LLP.
